description: Inherent receiver metadata survives symbol moves for value, shared, mutable, temporary, and Box calls.
Array len and Vec methods resolve on owned values, references, Boxes, and temporaries.
Vec new remains an associated function with no method receiver.
A resolved inherent method still checks ordinary argument types.
Array len takes no explicit arguments.
An associated function without parameters is rejected normally in a dot call.
An owned first parameter does not turn an associated function into a method.
A shared first parameter does not turn an associated function into a method.
Existing mutable references reborrow through immutable bindings, arrays, Boxes, mutable vectors, and nested mutable references.
A mutable shared-reference binding cannot grant mutable access to its target.
Reborrowing a stored mutable reference cannot bypass an immutable Vec index.
Clone uses exact receiver candidates and preserves value, shared, mutable, and inherent method priority.
